claims.title: Static collective rank, Bragg dark inputs and full-output photon-gate requirements

quoted_fields.interface: Declared equally spaced phase vector and fixed orthogonal projector for the modal theorem; supplied phase interval and norm target. Radiation geometry additionally needs normalized projection bounded away from zero, the stated ideal angular bath and validated grid/variation inputs. Bragg identity uses identical reciprocal local guided contacts, consistent free-reference port phases and an existing scattering limit. Band and cavity claims use their separately specified source classes.
quoted_fields.failure: Top eigenmodes optimize average capture, not automatically worst-frequency error. Rank r is not r emitters/poles, and a full frequency-adaptive N-mode Hamiltonian is outside the fixed-subspace premise. Good on-shell overlap/radiation geometry is not an acquired passive off-shell response. Prepared single-channel operations are different from arbitrary two-sided -I. Current governing numerical code/results are unacquired: reported rank5, sub-percent geometry and failed optimizer values remain source reports, not independent interval certificates, Maxwell devices or global impossibility results. Positive internal form/capacity is not a continuum gap or a gate guarantee.
